meta.title: SpaceX 6/4 re-mark — multi-scenario reconciliation

confirmed.basis: Baron S-1: SpaceX common repriced $135.00 (preferred $6,750) on 2026-06-04. Holding re-marks by per-share $105.32->$135 (+28.2%) to ~$4.99B -- NOT by $1.77T/$1.25T (+41.6%, which double-counts IPO dilution). Explains the +6.6% NAV.

meta.conclusion: Confirmed by Baron S-1: 6/4 SpaceX common repriced to $135/share (+28.2% vs $105.32), holding $3.89B -> ~$4.99B. $1.77T is the post-money whole-company valuation, not to be applied to the holding. (The earlier S1/S3 back-outs of $1.57-$1.61T agree; net basis confirmed by the 5/31 disclosure of SpaceX 23.2%.)
meta.disclaimer: SpaceX $-to-price mapping linear off the 3/31 NPORT anchor ($3.89B @ $105.32 split-adj). 6/4 reprice per Baron S-1. Next NPORT (period 6/30, ~late Aug) is the next hard confirmation. Not investment advice.

scenarios.name: Leverage accurate + Total Assets = gross
scenarios.fixed: L = 1.1358 (3/31 NPORT); treat 18.7B as gross (after leverage)
scenarios.note: Internally-consistent default: SpaceX backs out to ~$1.57T, a partial re-mark.

scenarios.name: SpaceX = full $1.77T (certain)
scenarios.note: For a full $1.77T mark to produce only +6.6% NAV, leverage would have to be 0.70x (<1 = net cash), impossible for a levered fund -> proves 6/4 is not a full mark.

scenarios.name: Total Assets = net (true AUM)
scenarios.fixed: L = 1.1358; treat 18.7B as net AUM (not post-leverage)
scenarios.note: If 18.7B is net, SpaceX backs out to ~$1.61T, still a partial re-mark.
